This place is the epitome of unprofessionalism and irresponsibility. They ruined my event and caused unnecessary stress. Avoid them at all costs if you care about your sanity and reputation!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hello Mr. Yadav,

We always appreciate feedback but prefer it to be fair and constructive. Let’s set the record straight with complete transparency:

We have reviewed your profile and seen your feedback about Barbeque Nation, where it seems the food didn't meet your expectations, along with a few other outlets. Given that, we may not place much weight on your average review. We, on the other hand, personally visit these places, and while we are in the same business, we genuinely appreciate their food. If your experiences don’t align, perhaps you should consider dining at Michelin-starred establishments.

1. The Root Cause: The issue with the rice occurred because it was freshly harvested from a new batch we specifically opened for your order. While fresh rice can sometimes result in slight texture variations, we tested the same batch with other team members, and they did not find it as disappointing as you have described.

2. Sample Approved: You picked up the sample beforehand, tasted it, and gave your approval. This makes your sudden dissatisfaction puzzling, especially since the same preparation process was followed for the final order.

3. Respectful Refund: The moment you provided feedback, we didn’t hesitate to offer a refund, despite the fact that your tone escalated with threats of a negative review. We respect every customer, even under such circumstances.

4. Price vs. Expectations: For ₹600/kg  Paneer Biryani (a price you negotiated from ₹600/kg and tried reducing to ₹550/kg), you seemed to expect gourmet-level biryani worthy of a five-star chef. To put this in perspective, high-end chefs charge significantly more, especially for large orders.

5. Pot: Asking us to collect the pot with leftovers still inside is unprofessional. Returning it clean, as is standard practice, would have been a simple gesture of mutual respect. Since we provide takeaways and delivery as a token of respect, and you came to collect a sample, I hope you understand. I agree where we are lagging, but be an effective communicator and then expect the same in return.

PS: You don’t need to disrespect the food, and as we mentioned during the call, you can recycle the pot. We will initiate your return as you have paid half payment ₹1500, but only once the pot is returned cleaned, since we didn’t promise delivery. If we are making this adjustment as a token of respect, we expect to be treated the same way.

We take pride in treating all customers professionally and upholding quality in our work. However, exaggerations and one-sided stories do not align with the mutual respect that makes association meaningful.

featured_reviews.name: Raviraj Samant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an enjoyable stay here. There are some positive and negative points about this property which I will list below.

Pros:

The rooms are clean and the bedding is great. Had an undisturbed overnight sleep. Sheets and pillows were clean. Flooring and storage facilities were also clean.

The A/C was new and working perfectly. No complaints. The remote was functional too.

The space is ample for two. And lights are bright enough.

Food is excellent! The pizza was absolutely smashing! The thukpa soup and veg fried rice was also good. Chicken crispy tasted excellent but was initially served without schezwan chutney which they promptly delivered in sometime.

Cons:

Only 1 bottle was provided for free where else 2 bottles is the norm. Also only 1 towel was provided but we did not use it anyway because of the reason below.

The bathroom was clean but the bucket and mug were old. The mug had broken handle and was unusable. Could not figure out how to get hot water but did not bother asking about it.

The toilet pot is clean but has hard water stains which look ugly. Need thorough cleaning. The bathroom also needs a ventilation exhaust fan.

The bathroom door lock was not functioning, had to use the secondary lock.

The TV was working but the remote control for TV as well as the dish had old leaky batteries. Only few buttons were working. We had to exchange batteries between the two to operate one or the other.

The food is excellent but is priced a bit higher than expectations. Even if we leave food price aside since the quality is good, the cold drink and water is almost priced double of MRP, like an alcoholic.

And GST is charged on top of that inflated cold drink and water pricing which I feel is wrong. It’s like one charge on top of another.

Lastly, check in process took some time and was slow. Don’t know why they need 2 phone numbers when the norm is just for the one who booked. Process can be made quicker.

Overall I enjoyed the stay but it could have been better. I am happy with it but if they improve on the above things, I will definitely come back and recommend.

It’s a value for money stay.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Raviraj,
Thank you for sharing your detailed insights. It's wonderful to hear that you found the room clean and comfortable, and that you enjoyed our delicious food offerings, especially the pizza! 

Regards, 
Team Farmhouse

It's extremely concerning about the quality and authenticity of the food at this restaurant. I recently ordered the Chicken Tikka Biryani, which I had tried a few months ago and enjoyed, with actual chicken tikka pieces. However, my latest order was completely disappointing.

The pieces in my order were blackened, the texture was wrong, and when shredded, the inside appeared red. The taste was unlike chicken or mutton, and it seemed like some other kind of meat, though I am not certain. This raises serious doubts about what is being served as "chicken."

When I called the restaurant to raise this issue, the response was unprofessional and dismissive. A staff member claimed that the chicken turns black when fried and directed me to resolve it with the seller. Even after being escalated to a superior, the concern was treated casually, and the only resolution offered was a refund.

While I have received the refund, the bigger issue is the apparent low quality and questionable nature of the meat used. I strongly caution anyone ordering chicken dishes from this restaurant.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at New Chaya Lunch Home, and I must say, the experience was both delightful and satisfying. The restaurant offers a perfect blend of affordability and great taste, making it an ideal spot for both casual meals and family gatherings.

Starting with the "Chicken Biryani", the dish was fragrant and rich in flavor. The tender pieces of chicken were well-marinated and paired perfectly with the subtly spiced rice. It was neither too heavy nor too mild, striking the perfect balance.

The "Chicken Kala Masala" was another standout. The robust, maharashtrian gravy complemented the succulent chicken pieces, offering layers of deep flavors with every bite. If you're a fan of bold spices, this dish will not disappoint.

The "Chapatis "were soft and freshly made, ideal for mopping up the generous curries. Alongside, the "Chicken Tikka" was wonderfully grilled, with a smoky flavor and perfectly charred exterior that contrasted well with the tender, juicy meat inside.

I also tried the "Chicken Manchow Soup", which was comforting and flavorful, with the right amount of spice and crunch.

Overall, New Chaya Lunch Home provides an exceptional dining experience with its delicious, reasonably priced offerings. It's a must-visit for anyone in the area looking to enjoy homestyle Indian food.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Cafe Relish is a really beautiful and well-maintained place with a great ambiance. The environment is calm, clean, and perfect for relaxing after a movie or spending quality time with friends. The cafe is located right next to Dattani Mall, which makes it very convenient, and parking is also easily available. You can also find sharing autos from the mall to the station for around ₹25 per seat, which is very helpful.
I have tried multiple dishes here, and the food quality is consistently good. The taste is impressive, and the presentation is nice as well. The quantity is decent — not enough for two people fully, but one and a half people can comfortably enjoy a meal. The menu is quite wide, offering a variety of options across cuisines, and the pricing is reasonable. Chinese dishes are available roughly between ₹300 to ₹500, which feels worth it for the quality and portion.
They also have a common washroom for both gents and ladies, and it is clean and well-maintained, which is a big plus.
Overall, Cafe Relish is a great place to visit. After watching a movie nearby, it’s a perfect spot to come and enjoy good food. Definitely recommended!

The interiors are tastefully decorated, featuring comfortable seating and thematic accessories that create a cozy atmosphere . The staff is courteous and attentive, enhancing the overall experience.

During my visit, I tried the Veg Supreme Pizza, Relish Special Pasta Delight, and Death by Chocolate Cappuccino. The Veg Supreme Pizza was generously topped with fresh vegetables and had a crispy crust, priced at ₹479 . The Relish Special Pasta Delight, at ₹389, featured mixed fresh veggies tossed in a chef’s special sauce, offering a delightful blend of flavors . The Death by Chocolate Cappuccino, costing ₹249, was rich and indulgent, combining whole milk, coffee, and chocolate fudge . The total cost for the meal was ₹1,204, which I found to be reasonable for the quality and portion sizes.

While the food and ambiance were commendable, the service was notably slow, which slightly detracted from the overall experience. However, the staff's politeness and the restaurant's cleanliness made up for the delay.

In conclusion, Cafe Relish is a great spot in Vasai for those looking to enjoy a variety of delicious dishes in a pleasant setting. Despite the slow service, the quality of food and the welcoming environment make it a place worth visiting.

featured_reviews.name: Sulabh Sanjay
featured_reviews.review_text: We visited Kerala Café, Vasai after seeing several recommendations on Instagram reels. Being a Malayalee, I was quite eager to try it out. We went in the afternoon and were asked by one of the waiters to wait outside due to crowding. My family and I waited patiently, but after a while, we noticed other groups being seated, eating, and leaving, while we were still waiting outside.When we followed up, we realized that the waiter had completely forgotten about us. Each time we asked, he simply said that the tables were being cleaned, but in reality, other waiting groups were being seated before us. It clearly showed complete mismanagement and a lack of real interest in customer service.The ambience was nice enough, but the food was not as tasty as expected and definitely not worth the hype. The prices were also quite high for the quality offered. To make it worse, there was a lot of noise coming from the kitchen almost as if a fight was going on inside, haha.It seems that the restaurant relies heavily on social media popularity rather than genuine service or taste. Overall, it was a huge disappointment; we ended up waiting for nearly an hour due to their poor management, making it a regrettable experience for me and my family.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi! Sulabh,
This experience is very concerning, and I sincerely apologize for the lack of attention and care you received during your visit. The situation you described regarding the seating mismanagement is unacceptable, and we are taking immediate steps to ensure better communication among our staff to prevent this from happening in the future. Your feedback will be a catalyst for improving our service standards.
Regards,
Team Kerala Cafe, Vasai

We have always enjoyed the food at Kerala Cafe,  Vasai. And the service is also top quality always.
